title: Sable and the Crown
author: Ines Thornbury
blurb: Ada Iversen, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
